provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Unmatched: Hell's Kitchen rulebook (Restoration Games, via RulesPal)

modules.name: Team play
modules.note: Needs a battlefield with 4 starting spaces.

steps.text: Choose a battlefield and place it on the table
Each player chooses a hero: action cards, character card, hero figure, sidekicks and health dials
Set hero and sidekick health dials to the starting health on the character card
steps.note: Sidekicks without a dial have 1 health

steps.text: Shuffle your action cards facedown; draw 5
One random Battlefield Item token on each designated space (faceup or facedown)
Younger player: hero on space 1, sidekicks on separate spaces in the same zone
Older player: hero on space 2, sidekicks the same way
Place heroes alternating: Team A 1st player on space 1, Team B 1st on 2, Team A 2nd on 3, Team B 2nd on 4; sidekicks in the same zone
Defeat the opposing hero to win (in teams, both opposing heroes)
Teams: turns alternate Team A, Team B, Team A, Team B; teammates may talk tactics
Free-for-all: on your first turn you may only attack the next hero in order or one who has already gone
The younger player takes the first turn
